items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Yes, yes, the Bird was there. He’s the one who wanted to get in the book so fast.

ctx.x: Was Charlie Parker on that particular group?
Um humm. Yes, yes, the Bird was there. He’s the one who wanted to get in the book so fast.
He wanted to show him something, huh? Was it shortly after that that you did a radio broadcast with him and opened it up with “Cherokee?”

items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I got Yardbird... He said, 'Well, okay, I'll give notice. I'll give him two week notice -- I'll give him a week.' I said, 'Give him two weeks' notice and take your time and come on in the band.'

ctx.x: Gene had been with her. But at this time, I got Gene, so that worked out good. And then I made a few changes and I got Willie Scott in the band. And let's see, Popeye left the band. After Popeye left the band, then I got Yardbird. So I had Yardbird --
Well, where did you hear him?
